For each group of lines answer the following questions.

  • What features do the equations in each group have in common?
  • Graph the equations on the same coordinate axes. What do you notice about the graphs?
  • How might you have predicted this from the equations?- For each group describe another example that has the same pattern.

Group A

Example 1

y = 3x y = 5 + 3x y = 10 + 3x y = 3x - 5

Example 2

y = -2x y = -2x + 4 y = 8 - 2x y = -4 - 2x

Group B

Example 1

y = 2x y = -½x

Example 2

y = 4x y = -0.25x

Example 3

y = -3x + 5 y = ⅓x - 1

Group C

Example 1

y = 2x + 1 y = 2(x + 1) - 1

Example 2

y = 5 - 2x y = 3 - 2(x - 1)

Example 3

y = 2(x - 1) y = 4x - 2x - 2
